description: This file is a shell script used to test and verify features related to 'git rebase' operations, including patch detection, patch application, and file attribute changes. It sets up various git repositories, commits, modifies files, and runs tests to ensure correct behavior of rebase and patch identification mechanisms.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: A shell function that reads lines from a file, and for each line (except the first), outputs the line to standard output. It then overwrites the original file with a scrambled version by shuffling lines.

search-terms: git rebase - test patch id computation
